reducedMotion: All CSS animations off (animation: none !important on every element and pseudo-element).
Hero braid is drawn completely at once: no intro tween, no scroll-driven draw; lane strands appear without transition.
Straight braids, single strands and bows reveal at full length immediately.
Weaves do not walk (the IntersectionObserver that adds .anda is never attached).
Hang tags and the voucher do not swing; pointer drag and entry pushes are ignored.
Counters and scores show their final value without counting.
Smooth scrolling is only enabled under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference; the success scroll uses behavior 'auto'.
Lane hover flood becomes an opacity fade (0.2s) instead of a clip-path wipe.
Transitions removed on lane icon, lane arrow, button icon, game disc and tabs thumb.
Game advances after 1400ms instead of 1100ms after a correct answer.

narrative.overview:
A single cord ties the campus to its bins. Five strands in the CONAMA 275 bin colours are braided in SVG into one helix: azul for papel, vermelho for plástico, verde for vidro, amarelo for metal and marrom for orgânico. The cord passes over and under the headline. It loops, unbraids above the bin lanes, and each strand turns off to run along the top of its own bin. When someone logs a discard, their bin's strand closes into a bow. The cord is the system's one recurring object. It serves as the divider, the ranking measure, the string that holds every label and the bow that signs off the footer. Pages are built around where the cord goes.

Everything else stays quiet so the cord can carry the colour. The ground is cool concrete-light and the ink is graphite. There is one display face at one heavy weight. Surfaces are flat, with no shadows, and controls are pills and circles. A bin colour appears only as a strand or as the field that strand floods. Each strand also has its own weave, so a bin can be read by texture before hue: satin for papel, twist for plástico, a hollow double line for vidro, beads for metal and knots for orgânico.

The density is mobile-first and one-handed, because people arrive from a QR Code beside a bin. Type is large, touch targets run from 44 to 56px, and the layout is one column that splits 7/5 from 760px. This world replaces an earlier torn-poster (décollage) look, which is retired. It also refuses the generic eco landing page: no leaf ornaments, no mint gradients, no grids of equal rounded cards.
keyCharacteristics: One five-strand SVG braid in the CONAMA colours, drawn along its length as you arrive and as you scroll.
Each bin has its own weave, so it never depends on hue alone.
Cool concrete ground (#eef0ec), graphite ink (#15181b), and bin colour only as strands and the fields they flood.
Funnel Display 800 for display type, capped at 6rem; Funnel Sans for reading; tabular figures for every count.
Hang tags on string serve as labels; they swing when pulled.
Flat surfaces. The only depth is the helix passing behind itself.
Bands run full-bleed, with the strand entering from beyond the screen edge.

rules.name: The Strands-and-Fields Rule
rules.body: The five bin colours appear as strands, as the fields those strands flood, and as their own bin's marks on its own surfaces: icon rings, list markers, the knot line and its buttons. They never tint a card, colour a heading or become decoration. Metal Yellow has one recorded exception. On ink it is the signal colour: the focus ring, the one call to action ("Ver o ranking"), the icon in an ink panel's heading and the live dot on the clock. Off ink it is used only for the text-selection highlight and the demo-mode banner. That exception is not a licence for more.

rules.name: The Metal Exception Rule
rules.body: Every bin field carries Sheet White text except metal, whose yellow field carries Graphite Ink (the `texto` value in `lacos.js`). The swap follows the strand too: on the yellow cover the single strand is drawn in ink with yellow beads. On the success bow, metal's beads are ink.

rules.name: The Linha Rule
rules.body: A bin colour used as text or as a line on a light surface uses its `linha` value, so every bin stays at least 4.6:1 on the ground.

rules.name: The 6rem Ceiling Rule
rules.body: No display setting goes above 6rem. Every display clamp, from the hero and covers to the page headlines and the footer wordmark, tops out at exactly 6rem. The large numerals stop below it (5.5rem and 5.6rem).

rules.name: The One Weight Rule
rules.body: Funnel Display appears only at 800, always with negative tracking (-0.02em to -0.04em) and a line-height between 0.88 and 1.08. Funnel Sans carries everything else, at 400 for reading, 500–600 for emphasis and 700 for labels and buttons. Every number that counts uses tabular figures. Nothing is set in uppercase.

rules.name: The Full-Bleed Band Rule
rules.body: The game stage, the competition panel, the gincana band, the bin cover and the footer each run edge to edge with square corners. Their strands start beyond the edge of the screen (x = −20 to −40px) and cross the whole band. A braid never starts or stops inside the gutter. The 22px radius belongs to contained cards only; an ink panel that becomes a band (`.comp`) drops it to 0.

rules.name: The Canal Rule
rules.body: On the home page the lanes reserve a corridor on the right (56px, 84px from 760px) for the descending braid. No text or icon enters it.

rules.name: The Helix-Only Depth Rule
rules.body: Shadows do not exist. If something needs to feel in front, it has to physically cross over something else, the way the cord does.

rules.name: The Over-Under Rule
rules.body: Where the cord meets type, it weaves through the letters and never strikes them through. In the hero it runs just below the baseline of "grandes laços.", so the letters stand on it and the descenders of "g" and "ç" cross over it. Inside "laços." it rises to 0.15em above the baseline, passes over the "l" and the "o" on a clipped over-layer, and slips under the "a", the "ç" and the "s". The tied trefoil knots use the same logic: their upper crossings are painted again on top.

rules.name: The Hang-Tag Rule
rules.body: A label is a hang tag on a string, hung from a strand: from the hero cord, from a cover's single strand, from the game's braid, or from the voucher loop. A tag hangs below the cord after its heading. It never sits above a heading as a kicker.

rules.name: The Real Strand Rule
rules.body: Every strand of the cord is drawn as SVG by `cordao.js` (`abertura`, `tranca`, `fio`, `laco`). A strand is never replaced by CSS stripes or gradients. The CSS weave (`[data-trama]`) is allowed only for one straight, static strand of a single bin, 4–6px tall, in its own weave: the knot line, the section dividers and the printed QR sheets.

rules.name: The Own Weave Rule
rules.body: Each bin keeps its own weave everywhere it appears: papel liso, plástico torcido, vidro duplo, metal contas, orgânico nós. A weave is never swapped, merged or dropped, and never lent to a surface that is not that bin.

rules.name: The Draw-Once Rule
rules.body: A strand draws along its own length and never retracts. Scrolling back up leaves the cord where it had reached. Weaves walk only while their braid is on screen.

rules.name: The Strand-as-Measure Rule
rules.body: When the cord carries data, its length is the data. Ranking strands are cut to true proportion on a shared ruler, the leader holds the whole braid, and there are exactly ten knots because ten is the cap.

rules.name: The Still Cord Rule
rules.body: Under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`, everything rests in its final state. Every CSS animation is off. The braid is drawn completely at once, with no intro and no scroll draw. Weaves stand still, tags do not swing or take pushes, numbers show their final value, and smooth scrolling is off. The lane flood becomes a 0.2s opacity fade instead of a wipe. Icon, arrow, disc and tab-thumb transitions are removed. Page transitions shorten to 0.12s. In the game, the next item waits 1400ms instead of 1100ms. Colour remains the only feedback.

dos: **Do** draw every cord, braid, lane strand and bow with the `cordao.js` engine, and pass the colour of the band behind it as `fundo` (#eef0ec on the ground, #fafbf8 on sheet, #15181b on ink, the bin hex on a cover), so the hollow and knot weaves cut through to the right surface.
**Do** carry each bin's weave wherever that bin appears: papel liso, plástico torcido, vidro duplo, metal contas, orgânico nós.
**Do** flood a whole field with a bin colour and pair it with Sheet White text, or Graphite Ink on Metal Yellow. Use the `linha` value when the bin colour becomes text or a line on a light surface.
**Do** cap display type at 6rem and set it only in Funnel Display 800 with negative tracking. Set every count in tabular figures.
**Do** run bands full-bleed with square corners, and start their strands beyond the edge of the screen.
**Do** hang labels as tags from a strand, with the 12px string loop, the pointed end and the punched eyelet, and leave about 70px below the strand for the swing.
**Do** keep touch targets at least 44px, and 56px for buttons and fields.
**Do** make reduced motion show the finished state at once: the cord fully drawn, the weave still, tags fixed and numbers final.
donts: **Don't** replace a strand with CSS stripes or gradients. No five-colour diagonal stripe (`--corda` is not a strand) and no striped band standing in for the braid.
**Don't** give a bin another bin's weave, or put a bin weave on a surface that is not that bin.
**Don't** use `box-shadow`, drop shadows, glows or blur. Depth is the helix passing behind itself.

**Don't** use bin colours as decoration: no tinted cards or panels at rest, no coloured headings, no gradients. Light tints of a bin colour (13–35%) appear only as state: the correct game choice, an empty knot on hover, the returning-visitor strip.
**Don't** bring back the eco landing page (leaf ornaments, mint gradients, grids of equal rounded cards). The leaf drawing belongs only to the orgânico bin icon.
**Don't** bring back the torn-poster/décollage world: no ripped edges, collage layering or paper grain.
**Don't** set display type above 6rem, use Funnel Display below 800, set text in uppercase, or use monospace as costume.
**Don't** put a label or kicker above a heading. Tags hang from the cord, after the heading.
**Don't** round a full-bleed band, or let a strand start or stop inside the gutter.
**Don't** strike text through with the cord. It weaves over and under the letters.
**Don't** let a strand retract on scroll, or animate a weave that is off screen.
